messages:
Lina (People Ops): Quick checklist for managers starting next week — condensed for copy/paste into your hiring folder. :sparkles:

Marcus (Hiring Manager): Thanks Lina. Can we flag billing + analytics as "must-have" by day 2?

Lina (People Ops): Yes — marked. Compact plan below:
- Pre-day: confirm laptop courier, complete payroll & tax forms, opt into equipment allowance.
- Day 0 evening: invite new hire to team calendar entries and add 30/60/90 draft slot.
- Day 1 AM: 30m team intro + 20m expectations chat with manager.
- Day 1 PM: IT handoff for SSO, Slack, email, VPN, analytics read, billing read.
- Day 2: Repo access + brief security walkthrough (Amber).
- Day 3: Assign a small onboarding task (doc/bug) for a visible first-commit.
- End of week: finalize 30/60/90, schedule skip-level, confirm recurring 1:1 cadence.

Ravi (new manager): Appreciate the clarity. For the 30/60/90, do we share with the skip-level?

Marcus (Hiring Manager): Share with your manager and block a short review with skip-level at 30 days (10-15m).

Amber (Security): Quick reminder: sign the data handling attestation before accessing production dashboards. Link in Handbook -> Security.

IT (deploy-bot): Provisioning note: analytics and billing require manager approval in the Access Portal. Tag your manager or reply to this thread with approval.

Ravi (new manager): I'll get the approval in the portal now. Also planning weekly 1:1s + biweekly team syncs.

Lina (People Ops): Great cadence. Template links (SSO): 30/60/90 template + intro email template available in the onboarding repo. Ping me to copy templates into your hiring folder. :white_check_mark:

onboard-bot: Reminder: submit equipment confirmation within 48h.
